notes.title: Update and Demo for Prequel
notes.content:
Dear Owlish Gourmets,

the demo for Owl Observatory, the prequel to Dinner with an Owl, is out now!
Experience a completely new adventure and dive deeper into the time-twisting mysteries of your owlish host.

Try the demo and add the game to your wishlist!

[previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;full][previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]


In addition to developing Owl Observatory, Dinner with an Owl also received some love!
The newly updated version includes the following changes:

 Added context-sensitive mouse cursors
 Items no longer stick to the cursor after use
 Adjusted the hotspot for Declan
 No more flickering in certain animations of Mr. Webb
 Some minor fixes


Let's have Dinner!

notes.title: Announcing Owl Observatory 🦉 🔭
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40104090/1af247a7e39dc9dc1c91b3ee27270fda5b13a42e.png

Friends of owlish dinners, I need your help: Please wishlist now and dive into a surreal world of horror, comedy, delicious dinners and time-twisting mysteries in Owl Observatory, the prequel to cult-favorite Dinner with an Owl.
Wishlist Now!

Story
Enter the enigmatic mansion of Mr. Virgil Brooks, a peculiar owlish gourmet who predicts the imminent end of time. 
Play as Tycho Brahe, the famed astronomer with the golden nose, and unravel the dark secrets lurking within the mansion and its eccentric residents. 
Time is slipping away — or is it?

Utilize your abilities wisely:

 Travel through time
 Clone yourself for devious deception
 Hypnotize the vulnerable minds


Features:

 Immerse yourself with full professional voice acting
 Navigate a twisted, looping storyline
 Be captivated by an eerie original soundtrack
 Reconnect with familiar faces from Dinner with an Owl and meet new strange characters
 Enjoy about two hours of gameplay


Eternity begins now - at the Owl Observatory! 
Are you ready for the unexpected?
